display.purpose: Names the active administration section in bold, high-contrast type.

body.purpose: Keeps navigation, tables, controls, and report labels consistent.

label.purpose: Uses bold uppercase 12px type for desktop table headings.

metric.purpose: Uses large 38px numerals to show current totals without fabricated trends.

shadows.name: surface-rest
shadows.purpose: Projects a crisp ink slab beneath outlined white panels.

shadows.name: panel-hover
shadows.purpose: Raises outlined metric cards on hover.

shadows.name: dialog-focus
shadows.purpose: Keeps the focused database dialog within the outlined visual system.

shadows.name: mobile-drawer
shadows.purpose: Separates the open navigation drawer from the page.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Provides brief feedback for hover, focus, and press states.

motion.name: loading
motion.purpose: Communicates active refresh or form submission.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The blue primary action for an administration task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; font: 750 14px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #0f172a; transition: background-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-hover); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #0f172a; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:active { box-shadow: 0 0 0; transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Filters records in the active section and supports a keyboard shortcut.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true"></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Buscar en esta vista…"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 12px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--muted); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--blue); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #0f172a; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: A current database-backed total with a compact semantic icon.
components.css: .ds-metric-card { display: flex; min-height: 148px; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 22px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #0f172a; } .ds-metric-card strong { font-size: 38px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-metric-icon { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--blue-soft); color: var(--blue); }

components.name: Report Panel
components.description: Contains one chart, occupancy view, table, or operation module.
components.css: .ds-report-panel { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #0f172a; color: var(--ink); } .ds-report-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-report-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Makes the selected admin section clear in the fixed navy rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 4px; background: #1e3a5f; color: #fff; text-align: left; font: 650 13px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item svg { color: #93c5fd; }

components.name: Availability Status
components.description: Pairs explicit availability text with semantic emerald or red.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); font: 650 10px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A high-contrast neo-brutalist console lets a restaurant manager scan current SQL-backed reports and open supported operations. Deep navy navigation anchors a near-white slate canvas; two-pixel ink outlines and offset slab shadows frame white panels, and blue carries actions while emerald/amber/red encode operational state. Current values remain distinct from date trends the source views do not provide.
keyCharacteristics: A 270px navy navigation rail with a responsive drawer.
Utility header with active-section search, database status, local date/time, refresh, and local administration context.
38px KPI figures and generously padded 15px table rows keep current reports legible.
Outlined components and solid offset shadows pair with tactile button press states.
SVG line icons and text-paired semantic states remain consistent across modules.

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Blue means act; emerald means available; amber means review; red means unavailable or occupied. Color is paired with text.

rules.name: The Fact-First Rule
rules.body: Use current SQL-backed values and never invent KPI trends or authenticated identity.

dos: Do show database-backed values and distinct loading, empty, disconnected, and error states.
Do keep every action aligned with the supplied stored procedures.
Do preserve table detail when a chart is limited for scanability.
Do pair status color with explicit text.
donts: Don't invent KPI trends, user identity, or sample data.
Don't use amber for primary actions.
Don't hide table overflow by shrinking data labels beyond readability.
Don't expose the local administration server to a public network without authentication.
